comment: What makes the AppImage of Immuch360 Desktop, each file pinned by its SHA-256 (desktop_installers.py appimage-tools). appimagetool (MIT) only builds the AppImage and is not in it. The runtime (type2-runtime, MIT) is the head of every AppImage: it statically links libfuse 3.15.0 (LGPL-2.1-or-later, with the patch of the type2-runtime tree), squashfuse 0.5.2 (BSD-2-Clause), musl, zstd, zlib and mimalloc (permissive licences); its source, the tree of the commit its release was built from, and the sources of libfuse and squashfuse its build script checks by the same SHA-256 travel inside the AppImage with their notice (usr/share/doc/immuch360/appimage-runtime).

sources.name: type2-runtime at dd6cebe, the source of the runtime and the patch it applies to libfuse
